justification: Changes the served flood planning answer in the flood tool and the site brief (102 of 310 saved checks change). Not Critical: only moves a false 'no' to 'not known' and drops extreme-only lines; one raise is a real planning-area hit. Not Minor: served answers change.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Fails if coverage is ignored, the near-edge rule is dropped, a failure returns no, or extreme-flood lines count as the planning map (each mutation measured).
falsifiable_check.external_authority: spatial_overlays live: 33 stored flood values all classified (DB test); NSW_Flood_Risk counts match ours for 56 councils; Spatial Services LGA resolved 75/75 height-layer misses.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Each of 4 deliberate breakages of the producer turned at least one test red.

pre_impl.existing_data: spatial_overlays flood: 33 values, 72 councils; spatial_overlays_coverage says 12 (stale, not used).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The old lookup said False whenever the table had any flood row, and True for PMF and non-flood rows.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One new producer module; the flood tool's own flood queries removed (producer lint 4->2 in flood_truth).
pre_impl.external_source_error: Spatial Services outage or DB error -> None with reason, never no.

functions.name: flood_planning_status
functions.what: Yes / no / not known for the council flood planning map at a point.
functions.input: lat, lng and an open database connection
functions.output: dict with value, reason, council, hits, nearest_m
functions.if_none: Any failure returns value None with a reason, never False.
functions.edge_cases: PMF-only hit, non-flood rows, council unknown, near the line
functions.failure_mode: At worst says not known where a no was possible

functions.name: _query_ses_flood_study
functions.what: Now reads the producer for in/out and its hits for tiers.
functions.input: lat and lng of the address
functions.output: ses_* fields plus flood_map_reason and council
functions.if_none: Producer None passes through as None.

break_it.scenario: Address in a council whose flood map we do not hold
break_it.what_happens: Answer is not known with the reason, not outside

break_it.scenario: Point only inside a PMF extreme flood line
break_it.what_happens: Not counted as the planning map; reason names the extreme extent

break_it.scenario: The height-layer council lookup fails for this point
break_it.what_happens: Spatial Services boundary names the council

verified: Regression on 310: 32 level changes, only raise has a real planning hit
